title: Chapter 2 — Rules of the Road
description: Act 2 begins: the daily loop, Sunday the conductor, Ada, and Scatter's first test.

cards.title: Act 2 — Rising
cards.text: The fuel price don rise. So has the sun. So, small small, will you.

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: From today, na routine. Morning: collect. Afternoon: collect, chop. Evening by nine: Baba Ticket share. Night: sleep with one eye. Rule number seven: routine na wetin dey save agbero from madness.

beats.speaker: sunday
beats.text: Shoki! Shoki! Oshodi! Oshodi! Enter with your change! Ehen, you be the JJC wey catch Bíọ́dún? Or the one wey Bíọ́dún catch? I no too hear well.

variants.text: Shoki! Shoki! Ehen, na you be the JJC wey Bíọ́dún wave for? Hahaha! The whole park dey wave like am now. Welcome, my brother!
Shoki! Shoki! Na you catch Bíọ́dún?! Ehen! Me na Sunday, the best conductor for this Lagos. My voice fit wake dead body. Hear: OSHODIIII!

beats.speaker: sunday
beats.text: Anything wey happen for this junction, I go hear am first. Na conductor be the radio of the street. Baba Radio just dey copy us.

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: Before you start, go Ada's Corner for market, buy me bread. And no do anyhow with Ada. That girl sharp pass razor.

beats.objective: Go to Ada's Corner in the market (north-east) and talk to Ada.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: Customer or trouble? Because you no resemble customer.

variants.text: Wait... na you carry that woman pikin go hospital? The whole market dey talk am. Customer or saint?
So na you be the new agbero wey increase fee for Back Side? The drivers dey curse you for my shop since morning. Customer or trouble?
Na you be the agbero wey no increase fee after fuel hike? Hmm. Either you get good heart or you no sabi maths. Customer or trouble?

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: Professor send me. Bread. And... good morning.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: Na me be Ada. This na Ada's Corner. Anything you wan buy, I get am. Anything you wan talk, I get ear, but e no free.

options.text: Help her carry the new cartons inside first
"Fine girl like you, you get boyfriend?"
Just buy the bread and go

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: Thank you o. At least you get hand. Plenty men for this market get only mouth. I dey save for university. JAMB this year. Then I go leave this market for my small brother.

variants.text: Boyfriend? I get JAMB. That one dey disturb me pass any man. Come back when you get your own shop, Mr. Back Side.
₦200. Next. ... You know say people dey greet before dem buy for this market? Okay. Agbero manners.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Ada goes back to arguing with a supplier about the price of Indomie. She wins.

beats.objective: Day {stat:day}: hustle. FEE RUN at the Back Side, eat, and have Baba Ticket's share ({quota}) by 9 p.m.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Three boys in orange walk into the Back Side like they own the shadow under the bridge. The biggest one cracks his knuckles. It sounds like a bag of groundnuts.

beats.speaker: kpakpa
beats.text: Na you be the new boy? Scatter say from today, Back Side go pay ₦1,000 every day. Protection.

variants.text: From us. And Bíọ́dún na Scatter cousin, so the price don include small interest. You understand?

options.lockedText: You and Professor never close reach

beats.speaker: scatter
beats.text: Ehen. You pay. Sensible boy. See you tomorrow. And tomorrow. And tomorrow.

variants.text: You touch my boy? For MY bridge? ... Okay. Na so e go be. Lagos small, JJC. I go see you.
Hahaha! See am! Kpakpa, help am get up. Na your ₦1,000 we carry, JJC. Next time, pay before you lie down.
Professor... Okay. Okay. Na your boy? We go talk am another day. No vex.

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: Scatter na small man with big mouth and short legs. Him no go forget today. Neither go Baba Ticket, because news for this junction dey travel faster than danfo.

variants.text: You pay Scatter? Hmm. Once you pay protection, you don become their ATM. Baba Ticket go hear say him agbero dey pay another agbero. E no go sweet am.

beats.title: End of Chapter 2 — Rules of the Road
beats.summary: Notoriety {stat:notoriety}. Ada bond {stat:friendBond}. Baba Ticket trust {stat:chairmanTrust}. Scatter now knows your name.
